title: Madhya-khanda, part 19 (portion 42)
html:
The section "The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff" (beginning): at Shantipura the Lord takes leave of the devotees and tells them to chant the name of Hari; Haridasa's plea; the devotees' sorrowful speeches; the Lord promises to live in Nilachala and consoles Shachi; Advaita laments that He feels no prema, and the Lord unties the knot of His cloth

The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. [Then] Bhagavan, having instructed the devotees to do good to all living beings by ceaseless chanting of the name of Hari, prepared to go to Nilachala; Thakura Haridasa, falling at His feet, poured out a humble and sorrowful plea. When the other devotees, telling of the grief of Shachi and Vishnupriya, began to follow the Lord, [the Lord] consoled them and Shachidevi with sweet words and, absorbed in prema, reciting the verse "Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, protect me" and others, set out for Nilachala. Then, [when, having given His staff to Nityananda,] He was walking absorbed in prema in an excess of bliss, Nityananda Prabhu broke His staff, and Gaurahari showed anger towards Him.1

Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, O brothers, sing the glory and the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) O brothers, my dear brothers, give up worldly desires: as long as you live in the world, do not leave the feet of Mahaprabhu!"

এইমতে শুভরাতি সুপ্রভাত হৈল ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' প্রভু আসনে বসিল ॥ ১ ॥

eimate śubharāti suprabhāta haila |
prātaḥkriẏā kari' prabhu āsane basila || 1 ||

eimate — thus; shubha-rati suprabhata haila — the auspicious night turned to a bright morning; pratah-kriya kari — having done the morning duties; prabhu asane basila — the Lord sat on His seat

1Thus the auspicious night turned to a bright morning;
having done His morning duties, the Lord sat on His seat.

দণ্ড-করে যেন সর্বরাজ্যের ঈশ্বর ।
অরুণ বসন অঙ্গে করে ঝলমল ॥ ২ ॥

daṇḍa-kare yena sarbarājyera īśbara |
aruṇa basana aṅge kare jhalamala || 2 ||

danda-kare — staff in hand; yena sarva-rajyera ishvara — like the sovereign of all kingdoms; aruna vasana ange — the reddish cloth on His body; kare jhalamala — glitters

2Staff in hand — like the sovereign of all kingdoms;
the reddish cloth glitters on His body.

যত নিজজন কাছে আছয়ে বসিয়া ।
হাসি' হাসি' কহে প্রভু সভা সম্বোধিয়া ॥ ৩ ॥

yata nijajana kāche āchaẏe basiẏā |
hāsi' hāsi' kahe prabhu sabhā sambodhiẏā || 3 ||

yata nijajana — all His own people; kachhe achhaye basiya — are sitting near; hasi hasi kahe prabhu — smiling, the Lord speaks; sabha sambodhiya — addressing all

3To all His own people sitting near Him
the Lord, smiling, speaks thus:

শ্রীনিবাস আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
আপন আশ্রমে সভে করহ গমন ॥ ৪ ॥

śrīnibāsa ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |
āpana āśrame sabhe karaha gamana || 4 ||

shrinivasa adi kari — Srinivasa and the rest; yata bhakta-gana — all the devotees; apana ashrame — to your own homes; sabhe karaha gamana — all of you go

4"Srinivasa and all you devotees,
go, all of you, to your homes.

নীলাচল যাব জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
প্রসন্নবদনে প্রভু যদি দয়া করে ॥ ৫ ॥

nīlācala yāba jagannātha dekhibāre |
prasannabadane prabhu yadi daẏā kare || 5 ||

nilachala yaba — I shall go to Nilachala; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; prasanna-badane — with a gracious face; prabhu yadi daya kare — if the Lord shows mercy

5I shall go to Nilachala to see Jagannatha,
if the Lord, with a gracious face, shows Me mercy.2

তোমরা থাকিবে, আজ্ঞা করিবে পালন ।
নিরন্তর দিবানিশি করিবে কীর্তন ॥ ৬ ॥

tomarā thākibe, ājñā karibe pālana |
nirantara dibāniśi karibe kīrtana || 6 ||

tomara thakibe — you will stay; ajna karibe palana — and carry out [My] order; nirantara divanishi — ceaselessly, day and night; karibe kirtana — you will perform kirtana

6And you stay here and carry out My order:
ceaselessly, day and night, perform kirtana.

হরিনাম, ভক্তসেবা করিবে স্থাপন ।
এই ধর্ম করি' যেন তরে সর্বজন ॥ ৭ ॥

harināma, bhaktasebā karibe sthāpana |
ei dharma kari' yena tare sarbajana || 7 ||

hari-nama bhakta-seva — the name of Hari [and] service to devotees; karibe sthapana — you will establish; ei dharma kari — practising this dharma; yena tare sarvajana — so that all people may be delivered

7Establish the name of Hari and service to devotees,
so that, following this dharma, all people may be delivered.

নির্মৎসর-অন্তর হইবে সর্বজন ।
সভে সভাকার মন কর আরাধন ॥ ৮ ॥

nirmatsara-antara haibe sarbajana |
sabhe sabhākāra mana kara ārādhana || 8 ||

nirmatsara-antara — free from envy at heart; haibe sarvajana — all shall be; sabhe sabhakara mana — all of you, one another's hearts; kara aradhana — honour

8Let everyone's heart be free from envy;
all of you, honour one another's hearts."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বরে ।
বাহু বেড়ি' সভাকারে আলিঙ্গন করে ॥ ৯ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu uṭhilā satbare |
bāhu beṛi' sabhākāre āliṅgana kare || 9 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu uthila satvare — the Lord rose quickly; bahu bedi — throwing His arms around; sabhakare alingana kare — embraces everyone

9Saying this, the Lord rose quickly
and, opening His arms, embraces everyone.

প্রেমজলে দু-নয়ান করে ছলছল ।
সকরুণ কণ্ঠ ভেল গদগদ স্বর ॥ ১০ ॥

premajale du-naẏāna kare chalachala |
sakaruṇa kaṇṭha bhela gadagada sbara || 10 ||

prema-jale — with tears of prema; du-nayana kare chhalachhala — both eyes brim; sakaruna kantha bhela — the throat grew tender; gadagada svara — the voice faltered

10Both His eyes brim with tears of prema,
His throat is tight with tenderness, His voice falters.

হেনই সময়ে সেই প্রভু হরিদাস ।
দন্তে তৃণ ধরি' পড়ে পাদাম্বুজ-পাশ ॥ ১১ ॥

henai samaẏe sei prabhu haridāsa |
dante tṛṇa dhari' paṛe pādāmbuja-pāśa || 11 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; sei prabhu haridasa — the venerable Haridasa; dante trina dhari — holding a straw in his teeth; pade padambuja-pasha — falls at [His] lotus feet

11At that very time the venerable Haridasa,
holding a straw between his teeth,3 falls at His lotus feet.

অতি আর্তনাদে কান্দে সকরুণ স্বরে ।
শুনিতে সকল লোক-হৃদয় বিদরে ॥ ১২ ॥

ati ārtanāde kānde sakaruṇa sbare |
śunite sakala loka-hṛdaẏa bidare || 12 ||

ati artanade — with a loud wail; kande sakaruna svare — he weeps in a piteous voice; shunite — hearing it; sakala loka-hridaya vidare — the hearts of all people break

12He weeps with a loud wail, in a piteous voice;
the heart of everyone who hears it breaks.

ব্যথিত হইল প্রভু সজল-নয়ন ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কিছু কহিছে বচন ॥ ১৩ ॥

byathita haila prabhu sajala-naẏana |
kātara-antare kichu kahiche bacana || 13 ||

vyathita haila prabhu — the Lord was pained; sajala-nayana — with tearful eyes; katara-antare — with an aching heart; kichhu kahichhe bachana — speaks a few words

13The Lord was pained, His eyes filled with tears;
with an aching heart He speaks:

এইমত ভাগ্য মোর হবে কতদিনে ।
পড়িয়া কান্দিব জগন্নাথের চরণে ॥ ১৪ ॥

eimata bhāgya mora habe katadine |
paṛiẏā kāndiba jagannāthera caraṇe || 14 ||

eimata bhagya mora — such good fortune for Me; habe katadine — when will it come; padiya kandiba — falling, I shall weep; jagannathera charane — at Jagannatha's feet

14"When will such good fortune be Mine —
to fall and weep at Jagannatha's feet?

কহিব কাতর কথা পাদাম্বুজ পাঞা ।
সফল করিব আঁখি শ্রীমুখ দেখিয়া ॥ ১৫ ॥

kahiba kātara kathā pādāmbuja pāñā |
saphala kariba āṁkhi śrīmukha dekhiẏā || 15 ||

kahiba katara katha — I shall speak words of distress; padambuja panya — on reaching [His] lotus feet; saphala kariba ankhi — I shall make My eyes fruitful; shri-mukha dekhiya — seeing [His] holy face

15Reaching His lotus feet, I shall tell Him of My distress
and, seeing His face, make My eyes fruitful."4

এ বোল বলিতে চারিপাশে ভক্তগণ ।
ভূমিতে পড়িয়া সভে করয়ে রোদন ॥ ১৬ ॥

e bola balite cāripāśe bhaktagaṇa |
bhūmite paṛiẏā sabhe karaẏe rodana || 16 ||

e bola balite — as He said this; charipashe bhakta-gana — all around the devotees; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; sabhe karaye rodana — all weep

16As He said this, all the devotees around
fell on the ground and wept.

চেতন হরিল শচী, কান্দিতে না পায় ।
ধরিবারে চাহে নিজ পুত্রের গলায় ॥ ১৭ ॥

cetana harila śacī, kāndite nā pāẏa |
dharibāre cāhe nija putrera galāẏa || 17 ||

chetana harila shachi — Shachi lost her senses; kandite na paya — she cannot even weep; dharibare chahe — she wants to clasp; nija putrera galaya — her son's neck

17Shachi lost her senses and cannot even weep —
she only wants to clasp her son by the neck.

কেহো পায়ে ধরি' কান্দে আউদড়-চুলি ।
অনেক যতনে তবে আপনা সম্বরি' ॥ ১৮ ॥

keho pāẏe dhari' kānde āudaṛa-culi |
aneka yatane tabe āpanā sambari' || 18 ||

keho paye dhari — some, clasping [His] feet; kande audara-chuli — weep with dishevelled hair; aneka yatane tabe — then with great effort; apana samvari — composing themselves

18Some weep with dishevelled hair, clasping His feet;
then, with great effort composing themselves,

শ্রীনিবাস, হরিদাস, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ ।
প্রভুরে কহিতে কিছু করে অনুবন্ধ ॥ ১৯ ॥

śrīnibāsa, haridāsa, murāri, mukunda |
prabhure kahite kichu kare anubandha || 19 ||

shrinivasa haridasa — Srinivasa, Haridasa; murari mukunda — Murari, Mukunda; prabhure kahite kichhu — to say something to the Lord; kare anubandha — make an effort

19Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari and Mukunda
venture to say to the Lord:

স্বতন্ত্র ঠাকুর তুমি, মো-সব অধীন ।
দীন দুরাচার পাপী, তাহে ভক্তিহীন ॥ ২০ ॥

sbatantra ṭhākura tumi, mo-saba adhīna |
dīna durācāra pāpī, tāhe bhaktihīna || 20 ||

svatantra thakura tumi — You are the independent Lord; mo-saba adhina — we are all dependent; dina durachara papi — wretched, wicked, sinful; tahe bhaktihina — and devoid of devotion besides

20"You are the independent Lord, and we are all dependent,
wretched, wicked, sinful, and devoid of devotion besides.

কি বলিতে পারি প্রভু — করিলা সন্ন্যাস ।
এখন ছাড়িয়া যাহ নিজ সব দাস ॥ ২১ ॥

ki balite pāri prabhu — karilā sannyāsa |
ekhana chāṛiẏā yāha nija saba dāsa || 21 ||

ki balite pari prabhu — what can we say, Lord; karila sannyasa — You have taken sannyasa; ekhana chhadiya yaha — now You are leaving; nija saba dasa — all Your servants

21What can we say, Lord? You have taken sannyasa
and now You are leaving, forsaking all Your servants.

একেশ্বর কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
ক্ষুধায় তৃষ্ণায় অন্ন চাহিবে কাহাতে ॥ ২২ ॥

ekeśbara kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |
kṣudhāẏa tṛṣṇāẏa anna cāhibe kāhāte || 22 ||

ekeshvara — all alone; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will You walk along the road; kshudhaya trishnaya — in hunger and thirst; anna chahibe kahate — from whom will You ask food

22How will You walk the road all alone?
From whom will You ask food in hunger and thirst?

শচীর দুলাল তুমি দুর্লভ-চরিত ।
দুখানি চরণ বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার সেবিত ॥ ২৩ ॥

śacīra dulāla tumi durlabha-carita |
dukhāni caraṇa biṣṇupriẏāra sebita || 23 ||

shachira dulala tumi — You are Shachi's darling; durlabha-charita — of rare character; duhani charana — Your two feet; vishnupriyara sevita — were served by Vishnupriya

23You are Shachi's darling, of matchless character;
Vishnupriya served Your feet.

ভক্তজন-নয়ন-অমিয়া-দিঠিপাতে ।
এ দেহে প্রেমার তরু বাঢ়ে হাতে হাতে ॥ ২৪ ॥

bhaktajana-naẏana-amiẏā-diṭhipāte |
e dehe premāra taru bāṛhe hāte hāte || 24 ||

bhaktajana-nayana-amiya — nectar to the devotees' eyes; dithipate — by [Your] glance; e dehe premara taru — in this body the tree of prema; badhe hate hate — grew before our eyes

24By Your glance, nectar to the devotees' eyes,
the tree of prema grew in this body before our eyes.

অনেক আছিল প্রেমফল-প্রতি আশে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া শূন্য করাইলা আশে ॥ ২৫ ॥

aneka āchila premaphala-prati āśe |
sannyāsa kariẏā śūnya karāilā āśe || 25 ||

aneka achhila — great was; prema-phala-prati ashe — the hope of the fruit of prema; sannyasa kariya — by taking sannyasa; shunya karaila ashe — You have emptied [that] hope

25Great was our hope for the fruit of prema —
and You, taking sannyasa, have emptied that hope.

পাপিষ্ঠ শরীরে প্রাণ না যায় ছাড়িয়া ।
ঘরে চলি' যাব তোরে বিদায় করিয়া ॥ ২৬ ॥

pāpiṣṭha śarīre prāṇa nā yāẏa chāṛiẏā |
ghare cali' yāba tore bidāẏa kariẏā || 26 ||

papishtha sharire — from the sinful body; prana na yaya chhadiya — life does not depart; ghare chali yaba — we shall go home; tore vidaya kariya — having seen You off

26Life will not leave our sinful bodies —
and so, having seen You off, we shall go home!

এখনে চলিয়া যাব মো-সব অধম ।
তোর ধর্ম নহে — তুমি পতিতপাবন ॥ ২৭ ॥

ekhane caliẏā yāba mo-saba adhama |
tora dharma nahe — tumi patitapābana || 27 ||

ekhane chaliya yaba — are we now to go away; mo-saba adhama — we lowly ones; tora dharma nahe — that is not Your way; tumi patita-pavana — You are the purifier of the fallen

27Are we lowly ones now to go away?
That is not Your way: You are the purifier of the fallen.

করুণা-কর্দমে তনু গড়িয়াছে বিধি ।
বিনোদ-বিলাস-লীলা দিয়া নানা নিধি ॥ ২৮ ॥

karuṇā-kardame tanu gaṛiẏāche bidhi |
binoda-bilāsa-līlā diẏā nānā nidhi || 28 ||

karuna-kardame — from the clay of compassion; tanu gadiyachhe vidhi — the Creator has fashioned [Your] body; vinoda-vilasa-lila — delightful pastimes and sports; diya nana nidhi — adding many treasures

28The Creator fashioned Your body from the clay of compassion,
adding the many treasures of delightful pastimes;

কেবল পরম প্রেমা — তাহে জীবন্যাস ।
ত্রৈলোক্য-অদ্ভুত রূপ করিলা প্রকাশ ॥ ২৯ ॥

kebala parama premā — tāhe jībanyāsa |
trailokya-adbhuta rūpa karilā prakāśa || 29 ||

kevala parama prema — pure supreme prema; tahe jivanyasa — into it life was infused; trailokya-adbhuta rupa — a form wondrous in the three worlds; karila prakasha — You have manifested

29into pure supreme prema he breathed life —
and You manifested a form wondrous in the three worlds.5

উপমা দিবার নাহি ত্রৈলোক্য-ভিতর ।
তোমার নিঠুর বাণী — জগত কাতর ॥ ৩০ ॥

upamā dibāra nāhi trailokya-bhitara |
tomāra niṭhura bāṇī — jagata kātara || 30 ||

upama dibara nahi — there is nothing to compare; trailokya-bhitara — in the three worlds; tomara nithura vani — [yet] at Your cruel words; jagata katara — the world is in anguish

30There is none to compare with You in the three worlds, —
yet at Your cruel words the world is in anguish.

এমত করিতে প্রভু না জুয়ায় তোরে ।
আপনে রুইয়া বৃক্ষ কাট' কেনে মূলে ॥ ৩১ ॥

emata karite prabhu nā juẏāẏa tore |
āpane ruiẏā bṛkṣa kāṭa' kene mūle || 31 ||

emata karite — to act thus; prabhu na juyaya tore — Lord, does not befit You; apane ruiya vriksha — having planted the tree Yourself; kata kene mule — why do You cut it at the root

31It does not befit You to act thus, Lord:
having planted the tree Yourself, why do You cut it at the root?

যে যায় তাহারে লহ সংহতি করিয়া ।
নহে বা মরিব সভে আগুনে পুড়িয়া ॥ ৩২ ॥

ye yāẏa tāhāre laha saṃhati kariẏā |
nahe bā mariba sabhe āgune puṛiẏā || 32 ||

ye yaya — whoever would go; tahare laha samhati kariya — take them with You; nahe va — or else; mariba sabhe agune pudiya — we shall all die, burning in fire

32Whoever would go — take them with You,
or else we shall all die, burning in fire.

হের দেখ তোর মাতা শচী অনাথিনী ।
সহিতে না পারি ইহার বিনাইয়া কান্দনি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

hera dekha tora mātā śacī anāthinī |
sahite nā pāri ihāra bināiẏā kāndani || 33 ||

hera dekha — look here; tora mata shachi anathini — at Your mother Shachi, forlorn; sahite na pari — we cannot bear; ihara vinaiya kandani — her plaintive weeping

33Look at Your mother Shachi, forlorn:
we cannot bear her plaintive weeping.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার কান্দনাতে পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
শূন্য হৈল নবদ্বীপ নগরে বাজারে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

biṣṇupriẏāra kāndanāte pṛthibī bidare |
śūnya haila nabadbīpa nagare bājāre || 34 ||

vishnupriyara kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; shunya haila navadvipa — Navadvipa has become empty; nagare bajare — in town and market

34At Vishnupriya's weeping the earth splits;
Navadvipa has become empty — town and market alike.

শূন্য যেন লাগে সর্ব বৈষ্ণবের ঘর ।
সভার বাড়ী যেন যোজন-অন্তর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

śūnya yena lāge sarba baiṣṇabera ghara |
sabhāra bāṛī yena yojana-antara || 35 ||

shunya yena lage — seem empty; sarva vaishnavera ghara — the houses of all the Vaishnavas; sabhara badi — each other's houses; yena yojana-antara — seem yojanas apart

35The houses of all the Vaishnavas seem empty,
and each other's houses seem yojanas apart.

যেখানে বসিয়া প্রভু কহিলে নিজকথা ।
দেখিলে মরিব — আর নাহি যাব তথা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

yekhāne basiẏā prabhu kahile nijakathā |
dekhile mariba — āra nāhi yāba tathā || 36 ||

yekhane basiya — where, sitting; prabhu kahile nija-katha — You, Lord, spoke of Yourself; dekhile mariba — if I see [that place] I shall die; ara nahi yaba tatha — I shall go there no more

36Where You sat, Lord, and spoke of Yourself —
if I see that place I shall die; I shall go there no more.

রহস্য-বিনোদ-কথা না শুনিব আর ।
না দেখিব নৃত্যাবেশ — প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৩৭ ॥

rahasya-binoda-kathā nā śuniba āra |
nā dekhiba nṛtyābeśa — premāra pracāra || 37 ||

rahasya-vinoda-katha — intimate delightful talks; na shuniba ara — I shall hear no more; na dekhiba nrityavesha — I shall not see the rapture of dancing; premara prachara — [and] the spreading of prema

37I shall hear no more intimate, delightful talks,
I shall not see the rapture of dancing, the spreading of prema.

নাচিবার বেলে আর না করিবে কোলে ।
না দেখিব অরুণ-নয়নে প্রেমজলে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

nācibāra bele āra nā karibe kole |
nā dekhiba aruṇa-naẏane premajale || 38 ||

nachibara bele — at the time of dancing; ara na karibe kole — You will embrace [us] no more; na dekhiba — I shall not see; aruna-nayane premajale — tears of prema in the reddish eyes

38At the time of dancing You will embrace us no more;
I shall not see tears of prema in Your reddish eyes.

হুহুঙ্কার-শব্দামৃত না শুনিব আর ।
কে মোর রোধিল কর্ণ-নয়ান-দুয়ার ॥ ৩৯ ॥

huhuṅkāra-śabdāmṛta nā śuniba āra |
ke mora rodhila karṇa-naẏāna-duẏāra || 39 ||

huhunkara-shabdamrita — the nectar of [Your] roaring; na shuniba ara — I shall hear no more; ke mora rodhila — who has shut my; karna-nayana-duyara — doors of ears and eyes

39I shall hear no more the nectar of Your roaring:
who has shut the doors of my ears and eyes?

কেমনে না দেখি' জীব তোর মুখচন্দ্র ।
নয়ান থাকিতে কেবা করাইল অন্ধ ॥ ৪০ ॥

kemane nā dekhi' jība tora mukhacandra |
naẏāna thākite kebā karāila andha || 40 ||

kemane na dekhi — how, not seeing; jiba tora mukha-chandra — shall I live, Your moon-face; nayana thakite — while I still have eyes; keba karaila andha — who has made [me] blind

40How shall I live without seeing Your moon-like face?
Who has blinded me while I still have eyes?

না দিহ বিদায় প্রভু — যাব তোর সঙ্গে ।
তোমার নিঠুর বাণী পোড়ে সব অঙ্গে ॥ ৪১ ॥

nā diha bidāẏa prabhu — yāba tora saṅge |
tomāra niṭhura bāṇī poṛe saba aṅge || 41 ||

na diha vidaya prabhu — do not send [us] away, Lord; yaba tora sange — we shall go with You; tomara nithura vani — Your cruel words; pode saba ange — burn the whole body

41Do not send us away, Lord — we shall go with You:
Your cruel words burn our whole body.

আহেড়ী ঘণ্টার রব যেমন করিয়া ।
কাছে মৃগী আইসে — তারে মারয়ে ধরিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

āheṛī ghaṇṭāra raba yemana kariẏā |
kāche mṛgī āise — tāre māraẏe dhariẏā || 42 ||

aheri ghantara raba — as a hunter with the sound of a bell; yemana kariya — does; kachhe mrigi aise — [and] the doe comes near; tare maraye dhariya — he seizes and kills her

42As a hunter, with the sound of a bell,
lures a doe near and then seizes and kills her, —

তেমতি তোমার প্রেম বুঝিল এখন ।
লোভ দেখাইয়া পাছে মার' কি-কারণ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

temati tomāra prema bujhila ekhana |
lobha dekhāiẏā pāche māra' ki-kāraṇa || 43 ||

temati tomara prema — such is Your love too; bujhila ekhana — we have understood now; lobha dekhaiya — having enticed [us]; pachhe mara ki-karana — why then do You kill [us]

43such, it seems, is Your love too — now we understand.
Why, having enticed us, do You then kill us?

তোমার বিচ্ছেদে ভক্ত সভাই মরিবে ।
ভকত-বৎসল নাম কেমনে ধরিবে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

tomāra bicchede bhakta sabhāi maribe |
bhakata-batsala nāma kemane dharibe || 44 ||

tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; bhakta sabhai maribe — all the devotees will die; bhakata-vatsala nama — the name "Affectionate to devotees"; kemane dharibe — how will You bear

44In separation from You all the devotees will die —
how then will You bear the name 'Affectionate to devotees'?

শচীরে বিদায় দিবে করি' কোন্ যুক্তি ।
তাহার সমীপে ইহা কহে কোন্ ব্যক্তি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

śacīre bidāẏa dibe kari' kon yukti |
tāhāra samīpe ihā kahe kon byakti || 45 ||

shachire vidaya dibe — how will You take leave of Shachi; kari kon yukti — by what means; tahara samipe — to her; iha kahe kon vyakti — who will tell this

45How will You take leave of Shachi?
Who will tell her this?

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মরিব শবদমাত্র শুনি' ।
এ কথার সম্বিধান করহ আপনি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā mariba śabadamātra śuni' |
e kathāra sambidhāna karaha āpani || 46 ||

vishnupriya mariba — Vishnupriya will die; shabada-matra shuni — on merely hearing the word; e kathara samvidhana — the arrangement of this matter; karaha apani — make Yourself

46Vishnupriya will die on merely hearing of it:
settle this matter Yourself."

এতেক বচন যবে ভক্তগণ বৈল ।
অন্তর-করুণ প্রভু কহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৭ ॥

eteka bacana yabe bhaktagaṇa baila |
antara-karuṇa prabhu kahite lāgila || 47 ||

eteka bachana — these words; yabe bhakta-gana baila — when the devotees spoke; antara-karuna prabhu — the Lord, compassionate at heart; kahite lagila — began to speak

47When the devotees had spoken such words,
the Lord, compassionate at heart, began to speak:

শুনহ সকল ভক্ত বচন প্রচুর ।
কোনকালে তো-সভারে নহিব নিঠুর ॥ ৪৮ ॥

śunaha sakala bhakta bacana pracura |
konakāle to-sabhāre nahiba niṭhura || 48 ||

shunaha sakala bhakta — hear, all you devotees; bachana prachura — My full word; konakale — never; to-sabhare nahiba nithura — shall I be cruel to you

48"Hear My word in full, all you devotees:
never shall I be cruel to you.

নীলাচলে বাস আমি করিব সর্বথা ।
সর্বদা আসিবে যাবে — দেখা পাবে তথা ॥ ৪৯ ॥

nīlācale bāsa āmi kariba sarbathā |
sarbadā āsibe yābe — dekhā pābe tathā || 49 ||

nilachale vasa — in Nilachala to dwell; ami kariba sarvatha — I shall certainly; sarvada asibe yabe — you will always come and go; dekha pabe tatha — you will see Me there

49I shall surely dwell in Nilachala;
you will always come there and see Me.6

আছিল-অধিক প্রেমা বাঢ়িব অপার ।
হরিনাম-সংকীর্তনে ভাসিব সংসার ॥ ৫০ ॥

āchila-adhika premā bāṛhiba apāra |
harināma-saṃkīrtane bhāsiba saṃsāra || 50 ||

achhila-adhika — more than before; prema badhiba apara — prema will grow boundlessly; hari-nama-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of Hari's name; bhasiba samsara — the world will float

50Prema will grow boundlessly, more than before;
the world will float in the sankirtana of Hari's name.

কাহারো হৃদয়ে না রাখিব দুঃখ-শোক ।
সংকীর্তন-সমুদ্রে ডুবাব সর্বলোক ॥ ৫১ ॥

kāhāro hṛdaẏe nā rākhiba duḥkha-śoka |
saṃkīrtana-samudre ḍubāba sarbaloka || 51 ||

kaharo hridaye — in no one's heart; na rakhiba duhkha-shoka — shall I leave sorrow and grief; sankirtana-samudre — in the ocean of sankirtana; dubaba sarvaloka — I shall immerse all people

51In no one's heart shall I leave sorrow and grief:
I shall immerse all people in the ocean of sankirtana.

কিবা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, কিবা মোর মাতা শচী ।
যে ভজয়ে কৃষ্ণ, তার কোলে আমি আছি ॥ ৫২ ॥

kibā biṣṇupriẏā, kibā mora mātā śacī |
ye bhajaẏe kṛṣṇa, tāra kole āmi āchi || 52 ||

kiba vishnupriya — be it Vishnupriya; kiba mora mata shachi — be it My mother Shachi; ye bhajaye krishna — whoever worships Krishna; tara kole ami achhi — I am in that one's embrace

52Be it Vishnupriya or My mother Shachi —
whoever worships Krishna, in that one's embrace I abide."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে পড়িয়া চরণে ।
সত্য কর প্রভু যেই কহিলা বচনে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā sabhe paṛiẏā caraṇe |
satya kara prabhu yei kahilā bacane || 53 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sabhe padiya charane — all, falling at [His] feet; satya kara prabhu — swear it, Lord; yei kahila bachane — what You have said

53Hearing this, all fell at His feet:
"Swear to it, Lord — to what You have said!"

সত্য সত্য সত্য প্রভু বোলে বারবার ।
নীলাচল-বাস সত্য হইব আমার ॥ ৫৪ ॥

satya satya satya prabhu bole bārabāra |
nīlācala-bāsa satya haiba āmāra || 54 ||

satya satya satya — "Truly, truly, truly"; prabhu bole barabara — the Lord says again and again; nilachala-vasa — dwelling in Nilachala; satya haiba amara — truly will be Mine

54"Truly, truly, truly," the Lord repeats again and again,
"truly I shall dwell in Nilachala."

শচীদেবী দাণ্ডাইতে নারে স্থির হৈয়া ।
দাণ্ডাইলা দু-জনার হাথে ত ধরিয়া ॥ ৫৫ ॥

śacīdebī dāṇḍāite nāre sthira haiẏā |
dāṇḍāilā du-janāra hāthe ta dhariẏā || 55 ||

shachidevi dandaite nare — Shachidevi cannot stand; sthira haiya — steadily; dandaila — she stood; du-janara hathe ta dhariya — holding on to the hands of two people

55Shachidevi cannot stand steadily on her feet;
she rose, holding on to the hands of two people:

নিদারুণ হৈয়া কোথাকারে যাবে তুমি ।
তোমা না দেখিলে বাপ মরি' যাব আমি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

nidāruṇa haiẏā kothākāre yābe tumi |
tomā nā dekhile bāpa mari' yāba āmi || 56 ||

nidaruna haiya — becoming pitiless; kothakare yabe tumi — where will you go; toma na dekhile bapa — not seeing you, my son; mari yaba ami — I shall die

56"Where will you go, having become pitiless?
Not seeing you, my son, I shall die.

সভে তোর বদন দেখিব কতবার ।
আমি অভাগিনী মুখ না দেখিব আর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

sabhe tora badana dekhiba katabāra |
āmi abhāginī mukha nā dekhiba āra || 57 ||

sabhe tora badana — all will see your face; dekhiba katabara — many times; ami abhagini — I, unfortunate; mukha na dekhiba ara — shall see [your] face no more

57Everyone else will see your face many times —
but I, unfortunate, shall see it no more.

সভার প্রবোধ বাছা করিলে আপনে ।
আমার প্রবোধ বাপ হইব কেমনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

sabhāra prabodha bāchā karile āpane |
āmāra prabodha bāpa haiba kemane || 58 ||

sabhara prabodha — everyone's consolation; bachha karile apane — you yourself, child, have given; amara prabodha bapa — my consolation, son; haiba kemane — how will it be

58You yourself, child, have consoled everyone —
but who, my son, will console me?

আমার দ্বিতীয় কেহো নাহি এ সংসারে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া শেলমাত্র বুকের ভিতরে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

āmāra dbitīẏa keho nāhi e saṃsāre |
biṣṇupriẏā śelamātra bukera bhitare || 59 ||

amara dvitiya keho nahi — I have no one else; e samsare — in this world; vishnupriya shela-matra — Vishnupriya is but a spear; bukera bhitare — within my breast

59I have no one else in this world,
and Vishnupriya is like a spear lodged in my breast."

হাসিয়া কহেন প্রভু সকরুণ-হিয়া ।
মিছা শোকে মর পূর্বজ্ঞান পাশরিয়া ॥ ৬০ ॥

hāsiẏā kahena prabhu sakaruṇa-hiẏā |
michā śoke mara pūrbajñāna pāśariẏā || 60 ||

hasiya kahena prabhu — the Lord says, smiling; sakaruna-hiya — with a compassionate heart; michha shoke mara — you die of vain grief; purva-jnana pashariya — forgetting your former knowledge

60Smiling, with a compassionate heart, the Lord says:
"You are dying of vain grief, forgetting what you knew before.7

চলি' যাহ, শোক কিছু না করিহ চিতে ।
নির্মৎসর হই' রহ সভার সহিতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

cali' yāha, śoka kichu nā kariha cite |
nirmatsara hai' raha sabhāra sahite || 61 ||

chali yaha — go home; shoka kichhu na kariha chite — keep no grief in your heart; nirmatsara hai — free from envy; raha sabhara sahite — live with everyone

61Go home, keep no grief in your heart,
live with everyone, free from envy."

দণ্ডবত করি' প্রভু মায়ের চরণে ।
প্রবোধ করিল প্রভু কথার বিধানে ॥ ৬২ ॥

daṇḍabata kari' prabhu māẏera caraṇe |
prabodha karila prabhu kathāra bidhāne || 62 ||

dandavata kari prabhu — the Lord, prostrating; mayera charane — at His mother's feet; prabodha karila prabhu — the Lord consoled [her]; kathara vidhane — with well-ordered words

62Prostrating at His mother's feet,
the Lord consoled her with well-ordered words.

মায়ে প্রবোধিয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
সত্বরে চলিলা — উঠে কান্দনের রোল ॥ ৬৩ ॥

māẏe prabodhiẏā prabhu bole haribola |
satbare calilā — uṭhe kāndanera rola || 63 ||

maye prabodhiya — having consoled His mother; prabhu bole haribola — the Lord cries "Haribol!"; satvare chalila — He went off quickly; uthe kandanera rola — a loud wailing arises

63Having consoled His mother, the Lord cries "Haribol!"
and goes off quickly — a loud wailing arises.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য প্রভুর সঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
দণ্ড-দুই গিয়া প্রভু পাছু-পানে চায় ॥ ৬৪ ॥

adbaita-ācārya prabhura saṅge cali' yāẏa |
daṇḍa-dui giẏā prabhu pāchu-pāne cāẏa || 64 ||

advaita-acharya — Advaita Acharya; prabhura sange chali yaya — goes along with the Lord; danda-dui giya — after going two dandas; prabhu pachhu-pane chaya — the Lord looks back

64Advaita Acharya goes along with the Lord;
after going two dandas,8 the Lord looks back.

দাণ্ডাইলা মহাপ্রভু আচার্য-বিলম্বে ।
উত্তরিলা আচার্য কাঁকালি-অবলম্বে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

dāṇḍāilā mahāprabhu ācārya-bilambe |
uttarilā ācārya kāṁkāli-abalambe || 65 ||

dandaila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu stopped; acharya-vilambe — as the Acharya lagged behind; uttarila acharya — the Acharya came up; kankali-avalambe — holding His waist

65Mahaprabhu stopped, for the Acharya had fallen behind;
the Acharya came up, holding His waist,

বয়ান বিরস, ঘর্ম বিন্দু বিন্দু তায় ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কিছু প্রভুরে সুধায় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

baẏāna birasa, gharma bindu bindu tāẏa |
kātara-antare kichu prabhure sudhāẏa || 66 ||

bayana virasa — His face drawn; gharma bindu bindu taya — drops of sweat on it; katara-antare — with a pained heart; kichhu prabhure sudhaya — He asks the Lord

66His face drawn, beads of sweat upon it,
and with an aching heart He asks the Lord:

তুমি পরদেশে যাবে — এই মোর দুঃখ ।
তাহাতেই আর এক পোড়ে মোর বুক ॥ ৬৭ ॥

tumi paradeśe yābe — ei mora duḥkha |
tāhātei āra eka poṛe mora buka || 67 ||

tumi paradeshe yabe — You will go to a foreign land; ei mora duhkha — this is my sorrow; tahatei ara eka — and besides that another; pode mora buka — burns my breast

67"You are going to a foreign land — that is my sorrow;
but besides it another thing burns my breast.

আপন অন্তর-কথা করিয়ে গোচর ।
নিশ্চয় কহিবে প্রভু ইহার উত্তর ॥ ৬৮ ॥

āpana antara-kathā kariẏe gocara |
niścaẏa kahibe prabhu ihāra uttara || 68 ||

apana antara-katha — what is in my heart; kariye gochara — I make known; nishchaya kahibe prabhu — surely, Lord, You will give; ihara uttara — the answer to this

68I make known to You what is in my heart —
surely, Lord, You will answer me.

তোর নিজজন যত তোমার বিচ্ছেদে ।
কান্দয়ে কাতর হঞা পদ-অরবিন্দে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

tora nijajana yata tomāra bicchede |
kāndaẏe kātara hañā pada-arabinde || 69 ||

tora nijajana yata — all Your own people; tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; kandaye katara hanya — weep in anguish; pada-aravinde — at [Your] lotus feet

69All Your own people, in separation from You,
weep in anguish at Your lotus feet, —

আমার পাপিষ্ঠ হিয়া না দরবে কেনে ।
এ কাঠ-কঠিন, অশ্রু নাহিক নয়ানে ॥ ৭০ ॥

āmāra pāpiṣṭha hiẏā nā darabe kene |
e kāṭha-kaṭhina, aśru nāhika naẏāne || 70 ||

amara papishtha hiya — my sinful heart; na darabe kene — why does it not melt; e katha-kathina — it is hard as wood; ashru nahika nayane — there are no tears in my eyes

70why then does my sinful heart not melt?
It is hard as wood; there are no tears in my eyes.

আমার অধিক আর দুরাচার নাহি ।
তোমার বিচ্ছেদে হিয়ায় প্রেমা উঠে নাহি ॥ ৭১ ॥

āmāra adhika āra durācāra nāhi |
tomāra bicchede hiẏāẏa premā uṭhe nāhi || 71 ||

amara adhika — worse than me; ara durachara nahi — there is no wicked one; tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; hiyaya prema uthe nahi — no prema rises in my heart

71There is no one more wicked than I:
in separation from You no prema rises in my heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু হাসি' কৈল কোলে ।
কহিব ইহার তত্ত্ব — শুন মোর বোলে ॥ ৭২ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu hāsi' kaila kole |
kahiba ihāra tattba — śuna mora bole || 72 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; prabhu hasi kaila kole — the Lord, smiling, embraced [Him]; kahiba ihara tattva — I shall tell You the truth of this; shuna mora bole — hear My words

72Hearing this, the Lord smiled and embraced Him:
"I shall tell You the truth of it — hear My words.

তোমার প্রেমায় আমি ছাড়িতে না পারি ।
তে-কারণে তোর প্রেমা গাঁঠিতে সম্বরি ॥ ৭৩ ॥

tomāra premāẏa āmi chāṛite nā pāri |
te-kāraṇe tora premā gāṁṭhite sambari || 73 ||

tomara premaya — because of Your prema; ami chhadite na pari — I could not leave; te-karane — therefore; tora prema ganthite samvari — I keep Your prema tied up in a knot

73Because of Your prema I could not have left —
therefore I keep Your prema tied up in a knot."9

ইহা বলি' আউলাইলা বসনের গ্রন্থি ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর সে আচার্য মনে চিন্তি' ॥ ৭৪ ॥

ihā bali' āulāilā basanera granthi |
premāẏa bibhora se ācārya mane cinti' || 74 ||

iha bali — saying this; aulaila vasanera granthi — [the Lord] untied the knot of His cloth; premaya vibhora — overwhelmed with prema; se acharya mane chinti — the Acharya, thinking [of Him]

74Saying this, He untied the knot of His cloth, —
and the Acharya, thinking of Him, became intoxicated with prema:

নয়ন-সাগরে বহে সাত পাঁচ ধারা ।
নির্ভর প্রেমায় সম্বেদন নাহি তারা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

naẏana-sāgare bahe sāta pāṁca dhārā |
nirbhara premāẏa sambedana nāhi tārā || 75 ||

nayana-sagare — from the ocean of His eyes; bahe sata pancha dhara — five, seven streams flow; nirbhara premaya — in boundless prema; samvedana nahi tara — He lost awareness

75from the ocean of His eyes flowed five, seven streams;
in boundless prema He lost all awareness.

পড়িলা অদ্বৈত প্রভু 'শ্রীচৈতন্য' বলি' ।
চৈতন্য-বিয়োগে গড়াগড়ি যায় ধূলি ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

paṛilā adbaita prabhu 'śrīcaitanya' bali' |
caitanya-biẏoge gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa dhūli || 75+1 ||

padila advaita prabhu — Advaita Prabhu fell; shri-chaitanya bali — crying "Sri Chaitanya!"; chaitanya-viyoge — in separation from Chaitanya; gadagadi yaya dhuli — he rolls in the dust

75+1Advaita Prabhu fell, crying "Sri Chaitanya!"10
and rolls in the dust in separation from Chaitanya.

দেখিলেন মহাপ্রভু অদ্বৈত-বিলম্ব ।
পুন গাঁঠি বান্ধে প্রভু — অদ্বৈত সম্বন্ধ ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

dekhilena mahāprabhu adbaita-bilamba |
puna gāṁṭhi bāndhe prabhu — adbaita sambandha || 75+2 ||

dekhilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu saw; advaita-vilamba — that Advaita was held back; puna ganthi bandhe prabhu — the Lord ties the knot again; advaita sambandha — [binding] Advaita's [prema]

75+2Seeing that Advaita could not go on,
the Lord ties the knot again, [binding] His prema.

আস্তেব্যস্তে সম্বরণ করিলা ঠাকুর ।
সম্বরণ কৈল তবে আচার্য চতুর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

āstebyaste sambaraṇa karilā ṭhākura |
sambaraṇa kaila tabe ācārya catura || 76 ||

astevyaste — hastily; samvarana karila thakura — the Lord restrained [it]; samvarana kaila tabe — then composed Himself; acharya chatura — the wise Acharya

76Hastily the Lord restrained it,
and then the wise Acharya composed Himself.

এই ত কারণে তোর প্রেমা উঠে নাই ।
তোমার প্রেমায় আমি চলিতে না পাই ॥ ৭৭ ॥

ei ta kāraṇe tora premā uṭhe nāi |
tomāra premāẏa āmi calite nā pāi || 77 ||

ei ta karane — for this very reason; tora prema uthe nai — Your prema does not rise; tomara premaya — because of Your prema; ami chalite na pai — I could not go on

77"That is why Your prema does not rise:
because of Your prema I could not go on.

তোর প্রেমার বশ আমি — শুনহ আচার্য ।
পূর্ব সোঙরণ কর, বিচারহ কার্য ॥ ৭৮ ॥

tora premāra baśa āmi — śunaha ācārya |
pūrba soṅaraṇa kara, bicāraha kārya || 78 ||

tora premara vasha ami — I am under the sway of Your prema; shunaha acharya — hear, Acharya; purva songarana kara — remember the past; vicharaha karya — and consider [Your] task

78I am under the sway of Your prema — hear, Acharya:
remember the past and consider Your task."11

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব গেলা আপনার ঘর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |
sakala baiṣṇaba gelā āpanāra ghara || 79 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; sakala vaishnava gela — all the Vaishnavas went; apanara ghara — to their homes

79Saying this, the Lord went off quickly,
and all the Vaishnavas went to their homes.

কহয়ে লোচনদাস গোরা-ঠাকুরাল ।
সন্ন্যাস নহে ত — বুকে রহি' গেল শাল ॥ ৮০ ॥

kahaẏe locanadāsa gorā-ṭhākurāla |
sannyāsa nahe ta — buke rahi' gela śāla || 80 ||

kahaye lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa tells; gora-thakurala — of Gora's lordly ways; sannyasa nahe ta — it is not sannyasa; buke rahi gela shala — [but] a spear left lodged in the breast

80Lochana Dasa tells of Gora's lordly ways:
this is not sannyasa — it is a spear left lodged in the breast.12

✦

Notes

  1. The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 15: "the Lord instructs the devotees to do good to all living beings by chanting the name of Hari; when He prepares to go to Nilachala — Thakura Haridasa's humble words to the Lord; when the devotees begin to follow — He consoles them with the sweetest words and leaves for Nilachala reciting the verse 'Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, protect me' and others; on the way Nityananda breaks the staff; the Lord shows anger"). The summary runs ahead: the journey to Nilachala and the broken staff are in the next portion.
  2. "The Lord" here is Jagannatha.
  3. A sign of utmost humility. Vv. 11–15 — cf. Murari 3.4.28–30.
  4. The Lord speaks in the mood of a devotee longing for the darshana of Jagannatha.
  5. A poetic image: the Lord's form is eternal and spiritual, and no one created it; the devotees, in their love, speak of Him as the most beautiful of creations.
  6. Vv. 47–54 — cf. Murari 3.4.24–26. The Lord kept this promise: the devotees from Bengal came to Him at Puri every year.
  7. "What you knew before" — that her son is Bhagavan Himself (this is hidden from her by yogamaya, which nourishes her motherly love: en/37, note 16). "Vain" (michha) means "futile", not "unreal" (en/37, note 14).
  8. A danda is a measure of time, about 24 minutes.
  9. Cf. Murari 3.4.32–33: Advaita asks why He feels no love on hearing of the Lord's departure, and the Lord replies: "If Your love had shown itself, how could I have left?"
  10. Vv. 75+1 — 75+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
  11. Apparently the Lord reminds Advaita — Maha-Vishnu in the form of a devotee (en/27, note 8) — that it was He who by His prayers called the Lord into the world, and of the work for which the Lord came, the spreading of sankirtana.
  12. In the 1983 edition chapter 15 ends here; the next chapter, "The Journey to Nilachala", begins with v. 81.
